lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a design cites an exact numeric formula coefficient add at least one hand derived exact value assertion for it not only directional greater than monotonic assertions a directional only test suite lets the coefficient itself drift undetected
lessons.text: When a design cites an exact numeric formula/coefficient, add at least one hand-derived exact-value assertion for it, not only directional (greater-than/monotonic) assertions -- a directional-only test suite lets the coefficient itself drift undetected.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec lists two related optional fields with independent fallback resolution as an edge case add a dedicated test that sets only one of the two tests that always set both together never exercise the independent resolution path
lessons.text: When a spec lists two related optional fields with independent fallback resolution as an edge case, add a dedicated test that sets only one of the two -- tests that always set both together never exercise the independent-resolution path.
evidence: spec.md Edge Cases: only one of two paired optional fields set (lib/measurements)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::verify a spec s cited i18n catalog namespace against the real messages file before writing the ac text a typed namespace name that doesn t match the existing catalog structure silently misleads whoever reads the spec later even when the implementation correctly follows the real pattern
lessons.text: Verify a spec's cited i18n catalog namespace against the real messages file before writing the AC text -- a typed namespace name that doesn't match the existing catalog structure silently misleads whoever reads the spec later, even when the implementation correctly follows the real pattern.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an acceptance criterion covers an absent dismissed null branch of conditionally rendered ui add a test that renders that branch directly instead of only testing the positive shown branch even if the unconditional class placement makes the negative branch look self evidently correct
lessons.text: When an acceptance criterion covers an absent/dismissed/null branch of conditionally-rendered UI, add a test that renders that branch directly instead of only testing the positive/shown branch, even if the unconditional class placement makes the negative branch look self-evidently correct.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec requires an exact clearance inset value e g npx to avoid overlapping floating chrome add a test that asserts the specific class value directly a value can be correctly wired in source yet remain completely unguarded by any test
lessons.text: When a spec requires an exact clearance/inset value (e.g. Npx to avoid overlapping floating chrome), add a test that asserts the specific class/value directly — a value can be correctly wired in source yet remain completely unguarded by any test.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a disabled gating condition is an or of several causes test each cause with a fixture where the other causes are false not just a fixture where multiple causes happen to overlap e g a blank pattern is both no pieces and no spec at once
lessons.text: When a disabled/gating condition is an OR of several causes, test each cause with a fixture where the OTHER causes are false, not just a fixture where multiple causes happen to overlap (e.g. a blank pattern is both 'no pieces' and 'no spec' at once).

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a ui notice s auto dismiss timer needs a fake timers test that advances past the duration and asserts the notice is gone asserting only its text tone does not prove the timeout actually fires
lessons.text: A UI notice's auto-dismiss timer needs a fake-timers test that advances past the duration and asserts the notice is gone — asserting only its text/tone does not prove the timeout actually fires.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires an element to move to a specific new position not just remain present assert that position class or dom order directly rather than only presence absence
lessons.text: When a spec requires an element to move to a specific new position, not just remain present, assert that position (class or DOM order) directly rather than only presence/absence.
